subject: Expansion stack pricing check-in
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion stack pricing check-in

Hi Alex —

Great to hear the BrightLane team is seeing lift from the pilot. We discussed a few ways to structure the expansion yesterday in the exec sync; wanted to align on next steps so procurement has a clean path. High level we can: 

- Offer a stepped-volume discount starting at +25% committed units (5% rebate), +50% (10% rebate), or a flat uplift credit for Q3 top-up.
- Co-term the new capacity into your Jan 1 renewal (preferred) or invoice as a short-term bridge for the remainder of this year.
- Provide a short SLA uplift for dedicated capacity at the +50% level (SLA credit for missed latency targets).

Two asks for us: can you confirm the expected monthly token consumption range (ballpark is fine), and whether procurement prefers a single amendment vs. an interim PO for Q3?

I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) and Irene (legal/ops) — Ben, can you draft the 2-sided scenarios and an attachment we can share with Alex?

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@brightlane.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Expansion stack pricing check-in

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the options. Quick answers: 

- Ballpark consumption: currently 18–25M tokens / month, but with the planned feature rollout we expect burst to 45M in two months. Practical committed increase we can promise today is +40% for the next 12 months if we can get a predictable price step and a co-term.
- Procurement preference: they prefer a single amendment if possible; if timelines are tight we'll accept an interim PO for Q3 followed by an amendment to co-term.

Procurement has asked for an itemized attachment showing the effective per-million-token price under each scenario and whether seat-based discounts can be layered. I’m looping in procurement at procurement@brightlane.ai to start legal review.

Alex
VP Product, BrightLane AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Expansion stack pricing check-in

Alex —

Thanks for the clear range. Attached is a short spreadsheet with three scenarios:

1) Bridge PO (Q3 only): no co-term, one-time top-up at 5% uplift on hosted per-token; effective price shown for volumes up to 50M tokens.
2) Co-term amendment (preferred): commit +40% annually, tiered discount applied (5% at +25% break, 10% at +50%); includes optional SLA uplift at +50% commit.
3) Hybrid: interim PO for Q3 + immediate amendment to co-term, with a small onboarding credit to offset the bridge.

Notes in the sheet: effective per-million-token price, expected monthly invoice delta, and a simple example of how seat-based discounts (for our support/monitoring addon) can stack. We deliberately left the seat-stack as an opt-in line to avoid double-counting discounts.

Irene — highlighted two legal caveats in the MA outline: (1) definitions of "committed units" vs. "measured usage" to avoid dispute windows; (2) a 60-day notice window for any SLA-tier changes.

Alex, happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the sheet. If procurement prefers, I can also export a single-page summary you can hand to legal.

Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- BrightLane_Q3_expansion_options.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- MA_outline_for_procurement.pdf (PDF)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@brightlane.ai>, procurement@brightlane.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion stack pricing check-in

Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for confirming the +40% intent. Next steps I propose: 

1) Ben to present the spreadsheet in a 30-minute call (this week) — Ben, can you do Wed 8/7 10:00am PT or Thu 8/8 9:00am PT?
2) Procurement to indicate preference for amendment vs interim PO by EOD Fri 8/9 so we can have legal draft the MA outline.
3) If amendment path chosen, Irene will prepare a one-page summary of the legal caveats and a redline-ready MA; if interim PO chosen, we’ll deliver the bridge quote + short invoiceable statement of work.

I’ll coordinate calendar invites once we lock a time. Goal is to have either an interim PO or signed amendment executed before the feature rollout in mid-September so BrightLane can rely on stable economics.

Lauren
Director, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
